nodes.text: Are there infinitely many $n$ such that, for all $k\geq 1$,\[\tau(n+k)\ll k?\]

#826 : [Er74b] number theory A stronger form of [248] . Lau [La26] has proved that there exists an absolute constant $C$ such that, for infinitely many $n$,\[\tau(n+k) \ll k^C\]for all $k\geq 1$.
